caption: The drawing depicts a round, intricately patterned object rendered in shades of gray on a plain, cream background. The object consists of a circular design with an openwork, lattice-like structure in the center featuring intertwining scrolls and curvilinear motifs. Around the perimeter of the circle, spaced at roughly even intervals, there are five rounded protrusions resembling knobs or feet. The edge of the circle contains a border of evenly spaced, small, oval or rectangular cut-outs. The shading suggests a three-dimensional object placed on a flat surface. The drawing appears to be created with graphite or a similar medium, with a smooth completion and subtle shadowing to convey depth. The artist’s signature, "Chas. F. Moss" followed by the year "1935," is visible in the lower left region of the image.
title: Trivet
